TE_FX_SHOCK_MINUS_10_DESC.es: La moneda se debilita: #v Índice de tipo de cambio#! en torno a #R −10#! a lo largo del próximo año, y luego se desvanece

TE_FX_SHOCK_MINUS_5_DESC.en: The currency weakens: #v Exchange Rate Index#! about #R −5#! over the coming year, fading after
TE_FX_SHOCK_MINUS_5_DESC.es: La moneda se debilita: #v Índice de tipo de cambio#! en torno a #R −5#! a lo largo del próximo año, y luego se desvanece

TE_FX_SHOCK_PLUS_5_DESC.en: The currency is propped up: #v Exchange Rate Index#! about #G +5#! over the coming year, fading after
TE_FX_SHOCK_PLUS_5_DESC.es: La moneda se sostiene: #v Índice de tipo de cambio#! en torno a #G +5#! a lo largo del próximo año, y luego se desvanece

TE_HOMELAND_CREATION_THRESHOLD_CLAMPED.en: \nThe modifiers below total #v [State.GetModifier.GetValueFor('state_homeland_creation_threshold_add')|%0]#!, but the threshold is held between #v 10%#! and #v 90%#!.
TE_HOMELAND_CREATION_THRESHOLD_CLAMPED.es: \nLos modificadores de abajo suman #v [State.GetModifier.GetValueFor('state_homeland_creation_threshold_add')|%0]#!, pero el umbral se mantiene entre #v 10%#! y #v 90%#!.

TE_HOMELAND_CREATION_THRESHOLD_TT.en:
#tooltip_header Creation Threshold#!
A primary culture without a [concept_homeland] here needs at least #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_form_threshold')|%0]#! of the state's population before its homeland can start forming.[SelectLocalization(NotEqualTo_CFixedPoint(State.GetModifier.GetValueFor('state_homeland_creation_threshold_add'), State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_form_threshold')), 'TE_HOMELAND_CREATION_THRESHOLD_CLAMPED', '')]
$TOOLTIP_DELIMITER$
[State.GetModifier.GetDescFor('state_homeland_creation_threshold_add')]
TE_HOMELAND_CREATION_THRESHOLD_TT.es:
#tooltip_header Umbral de creación#!
Una cultura principal sin [concept_homeland|l] aquí necesita al menos #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_form_threshold')|%0]#! de la población del estado antes de que su tierra natal pueda empezar a formarse.[SelectLocalization(NotEqualTo_CFixedPoint(State.GetModifier.GetValueFor('state_homeland_creation_threshold_add'), State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_form_threshold')), 'TE_HOMELAND_CREATION_THRESHOLD_CLAMPED', '')]
$TOOLTIP_DELIMITER$
[State.GetModifier.GetDescFor('state_homeland_creation_threshold_add')]

TE_HOMELAND_PAUSED_LOCKED.en: Paused: needs a #tooltippable #tooltip:[State.GetTooltipTag],TE_HOMELAND_PAUSED_LOCKED_TT law, principle or technology#!#! that enables homeland changes.
TE_HOMELAND_PAUSED_LOCKED.es: En pausa: necesita #tooltippable #tooltip:[State.GetTooltipTag],TE_HOMELAND_PAUSED_LOCKED_TT una ley, un principio o una tecnología#!#! que permita los cambios de tierra natal.

TE_HOMELAND_PAUSED_LOCKED_TT.en: #tooltip_header Enabling Homeland Changes#!\n[State.GetOwner.GetName] has not enabled homeland changes, so no [concept_homeland] in its states can form or disappear. Any one of these enables them:\n$TE_HOMELAND_UNLOCK_SOURCES$
TE_HOMELAND_PAUSED_LOCKED_TT.es: #tooltip_header Habilitar los cambios de tierra natal#!\n[State.GetOwner.GetName] no ha habilitado los cambios de tierra natal, así que ninguna [concept_homeland|l] de sus estados puede formarse ni desaparecer. Cualquiera de estas cosas los habilita:\n$TE_HOMELAND_UNLOCK_SOURCES$

TE_HOMELAND_PAUSED_SPLIT.es: En pausa: región dividida entre propietarios.

TE_HOMELAND_PROJECT_INVALID.es: Ya no cumple los requisitos; el progreso se reinicia.

TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD.es: Bloqueado: debe estar por debajo de #tooltippable #tooltip:[State.GetTooltipTag],TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_TT #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_disappear_threshold')|%0]#!#!#! de población.

TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_CLAMPED.en: \nThe modifiers below total #v [State.GetModifier.GetValueFor('state_homeland_removal_threshold_add')|%0]#!, but the threshold is held between #v 0%#! and #v 100%#!.
TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_CLAMPED.es: \nLos modificadores de abajo suman #v [State.GetModifier.GetValueFor('state_homeland_removal_threshold_add')|%0]#!, pero el umbral se mantiene entre #v 0%#! y #v 100%#!.

TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_TT.en:
#tooltip_header Removal Threshold#!
A non-primary culture with a [concept_homeland] here must fall below #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_disappear_threshold')|%0]#! of the state's population before that homeland can start being removed.[SelectLocalization(NotEqualTo_CFixedPoint(State.GetModifier.GetValueFor('state_homeland_removal_threshold_add'), State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_disappear_threshold')), 'TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_CLAMPED', '')][SelectLocalization(EqualTo_CFixedPoint(State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_disappear_threshold'), '(CFixedPoint)0'), 'TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_ZERO', '')]
$TOOLTIP_DELIMITER$
[State.GetModifier.GetDescFor('state_homeland_removal_threshold_add')]
TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_TT.es:
#tooltip_header Umbral de eliminación#!
Una cultura no principal con una [concept_homeland|l] aquí debe caer por debajo de #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_disappear_threshold')|%0]#! de la población del estado antes de que esa tierra natal pueda empezar a eliminarse.[SelectLocalization(NotEqualTo_CFixedPoint(State.GetModifier.GetValueFor('state_homeland_removal_threshold_add'), State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_disappear_threshold')), 'TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_CLAMPED', '')][SelectLocalization(EqualTo_CFixedPoint(State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_disappear_threshold'), '(CFixedPoint)0'), 'TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_ZERO', '')]
$TOOLTIP_DELIMITER$
[State.GetModifier.GetDescFor('state_homeland_removal_threshold_add')]

TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_ZERO.en: \nAt #v 0%#! no homeland here can be removed. Laws and technologies that raise the threshold make removal possible.
TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_ZERO.es: \nCon #v 0%#! no se puede eliminar ninguna tierra natal de aquí. Las leyes y tecnologías que elevan el umbral hacen posible la eliminación.

TE_HOMELAND_UNLOCK_SOURCES.en: [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws|q$')]: [GetLawType('law_ethnostate').GetName] ($lawgroup_citizenship$), [GetLawType('law_minority_rights_violent_hostility').GetName] ($lawgroup_minority_rights$) or [GetLawType('law_linguistic_purity').GetName] ($lawgroup_language_policy$)\n[concept_power_bloc_principle]: [GetPowerBlocPrincipleGroup('principle_group_cultural_unity').GetName] tier II or higher in the country's [concept_power_bloc]\n[concept_technology]: [GetTechnology('mass_media').GetName]
TE_HOMELAND_UNLOCK_SOURCES.es: [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws|q$')]: [GetLawType('law_ethnostate').GetName] ($lawgroup_citizenship$), [GetLawType('law_minority_rights_violent_hostility').GetName] ($lawgroup_minority_rights$) o [GetLawType('law_linguistic_purity').GetName] ($lawgroup_language_policy$)\n[concept_power_bloc_principle]: [GetPowerBlocPrincipleGroup('principle_group_cultural_unity').GetName] nivel II o superior en el [concept_power_bloc|l] del país\n[concept_technology]: [GetTechnology('mass_media').GetName]

TE_STATE_ANTIMATTER_TT.en:
#bold [concept_antimatter_facility] Slots#!
In Use: #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('antimatter_points_consumed')|0]#!
Reserved, queued levels included: #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('antimatter_points_reserved')|0]#!
Each [concept_antimatter_facility] level gives the whole country #v 5#! slots for Antimatter Engines and Warhead Plants.
TE_STATE_ANTIMATTER_TT.es:
#bold Ranuras de [concept_antimatter_facility|l]#!
En uso: #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('antimatter_points_consumed')|0]#!
Reservadas, con los niveles en cola incluidos: #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('antimatter_points_reserved')|0]#!
Cada nivel de [concept_antimatter_facility|l] da a todo el país #v 5#! ranuras para motores de antimateria y plantas de ojivas.

TE_STATE_CLIMATE_NO_DATA.en: No climate data for this region.
TE_STATE_CLIMATE_NO_DATA.es: No hay datos climáticos para esta región.

TE_STATE_CLIMATE_TT.en:
#bold [concept_local_climate]#!
The climate where most of this region's people live. Every part of a split region shares the region's climate. Comfort is what it costs the state in [concept_migration_pull].

Hover a reading for what it measures and costs.
TE_STATE_CLIMATE_TT.es:
#bold [concept_local_climate]#!
El clima de la zona donde vive la mayoría de la población de esta región. Todas las partes de una región dividida comparten el clima de la región. El confort es lo que le cuesta al estado en [concept_migration_pull|l].

Pasa el cursor sobre un valor para ver qué mide y cuánto cuesta.

TE_STATE_CROWDING_TT.en:
#bold [concept_migration_crowding]#!
#bold Crowding Threshold#! = ([concept_arable_land] × 10K + [concept_urban_engineering] × 1K) × (1 + Tolerance)
[concept_arable_land]: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('arable_land_base')|0]#! × 10K = #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('migration_crowding_land_pop')|Kv]#!
[concept_urban_engineering]: [State.GetModifier.GetValueWithBreakdownFor('state_building_construction_sector_max_level_add')] × 1K = #G +[State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('migration_crowding_urban_engineering_capacity')|K]#!
$state_migration_crowding_density_mult$: [State.GetModifier.GetValueWithBreakdownFor('state_migration_crowding_density_mult')]

#bold Crowding Ratio:#! #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('migration_crowding_ratio')|%0]#! #grey (0% at the threshold, 100% at ten times it)#!
TE_STATE_CROWDING_TT.es:
#bold [concept_migration_crowding]#!
#bold Umbral de hacinamiento#! = ([concept_arable_land] × 10K + [concept_urban_engineering] × 1K) × (1 + Tolerancia)
[concept_arable_land]: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('arable_land_base')|0]#! × 10K = #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('migration_crowding_land_pop')|Kv]#!
[concept_urban_engineering]: [State.GetModifier.GetValueWithBreakdownFor('state_building_construction_sector_max_level_add')] × 1K = #G +[State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('migration_crowding_urban_engineering_capacity')|K]#!
$state_migration_crowding_density_mult$: [State.GetModifier.GetValueWithBreakdownFor('state_migration_crowding_density_mult')]

#bold Proporción de hacinamiento:#! #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('migration_crowding_ratio')|%0]#! #grey (0% en el umbral, 100% a diez veces el umbral)#!

TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_CABLES_TT.en:
#b Undersea Cables#!
This state's $building_grid_hvdc_interconnector$ crosses up to #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_cable_range_disp')|0]#! [Concept('concept_sea_node', '$concept_sea_nodes|q$')] (#b $building_grid_undersea_cable_range_add$#!). It joins this state's grid to any station with a cable of its own when either one's range reaches the other: one of ours in another [concept_market_area], or one of a country we have a $grid_interconnection_agreement$ with. The number is how many stations it joins this way.

[GetScriptedGui('te_grid_cable_links_sgui').ExecuteTooltip(GuiScope.SetRoot(State.MakeScope).End)]
TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_CABLES_TT.es:
#b Cables submarinos#!
El $building_grid_hvdc_interconnector$ de este estado cruza hasta #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_cable_range_disp')|0]#! [Concept('concept_sea_node', '$concept_sea_nodes|q$')|l] (#b $building_grid_undersea_cable_range_add$#!). Une la red de este estado con cualquier estación que tenga un cable propio cuando el alcance de una de las dos llega hasta la otra: una nuestra en otra [concept_market_area|l], o una de un país con el que tengamos un $grid_interconnection_agreement$. El número indica cuántas estaciones une de este modo.

[GetScriptedGui('te_grid_cable_links_sgui').ExecuteTooltip(GuiScope.SetRoot(State.MakeScope).End)]

TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_EFFICIENCY_TT.en: #b Grid Transmission Efficiency#!\nThe share of the $electricity$ sent to this state's station that arrives: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_state_efficiency_value')|%0]#!. Rural Electrification, Transistors, Microprocessor, Clean Energy Technologies, Smart Grids and Quantum Materials raise it.
TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_EFFICIENCY_TT.es: #b Eficiencia de transmisión de la red#!\nLa parte de la $electricity$ enviada a la estación de este estado que llega a su destino: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_state_efficiency_value')|%0]#!. Electrificación rural, Transistores, Microprocesador, Tecnologías de energía limpia, Redes inteligentes y Materiales cuánticos la aumentan.

TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_HUB_TT.en: #b Hub#!\nThe grid's largest producer of $electricity$: #v [State.MakeScope.Var('te_grid_hub').GetState.GetName]#!. Every state on a grid names the same hub, so it tells grids apart.
TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_HUB_TT.es: #b Nodo#!\nEl mayor productor de $electricity$ de la red: #v [State.MakeScope.Var('te_grid_hub').GetState.GetName]#!. Todos los estados de una red nombran el mismo nodo, así que sirve para distinguir unas redes de otras.

TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_MARKET_TT.en:
#b Between Markets#!
This grid joins more than one [concept_market]. This state's market's stations on it #v [AddLocalizationIf(EqualTo_CFixedPoint(State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_market_dir_disp'), '(CFixedPoint)1'), 'te_grid_market_send_more')][AddLocalizationIf(EqualTo_CFixedPoint(State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_market_dir_disp'), '(CFixedPoint)2'), 'te_grid_market_receive_more')]#!, by #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_market_flow_disp')|1]#! $grid_power$ a week.

Stations settle in $grid_power$ at the grid's price, and its own price is fixed, so what crosses is paid for at that: a market's senders are paid for all they send, and its receivers pay for all they receive.
TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_MARKET_TT.es:
#b Entre mercados#!
Esta red une más de un [concept_market|l]. Las estaciones del mercado de este estado en ella #v [AddLocalizationIf(EqualTo_CFixedPoint(State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_market_dir_disp'), '(CFixedPoint)1'), 'te_grid_market_send_more')][AddLocalizationIf(EqualTo_CFixedPoint(State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_market_dir_disp'), '(CFixedPoint)2'), 'te_grid_market_receive_more')]#!, en #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_market_flow_disp')|1]#! $grid_power$ a la semana.

Las estaciones liquidan en $grid_power$ al precio de la red, y el precio de esta es fijo, así que lo que cruza se paga a ese precio: a los emisores de un mercado se les paga todo lo que envían, y sus receptores pagan todo lo que reciben.

TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_MODE_TT.en:
#b Mode#!
#v Sending#!: $electricity$ is cheap here, and the station sends the spare to the grid for $grid_power$.
#v Receiving#!: it is dear here, and the station pays $grid_power$ for power from the grid.
#v Idle#!: its price is too close to the grid's for the losses, or the grid has nothing to share.
#v Offline#!: not balanced yet; it joins its grid at the next month's balancing.
A thinly staffed station is asked for more, down to a fifth staffed; one with no staff moves nothing until it hires.
TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_MODE_TT.es:
#b Modo#!
#v Enviando#!: aquí la $electricity$ es barata, y la estación envía el excedente a la red a cambio de $grid_power$.
#v Recibiendo#!: aquí es cara, y la estación paga $grid_power$ por la energía de la red.
#v Inactivo#!: su precio es demasiado cercano al de la red para compensar las pérdidas, o la red no tiene nada que compartir.
#v Fuera de línea#!: aún no se ha equilibrado; se une a su red en el equilibrado del mes siguiente.
A una estación con poca plantilla se le pide más, hasta llegar a una quinta parte de plantilla cubierta; una sin personal no mueve nada hasta que contrata.

TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_MOVED_TT.en: #b Flow#!\nThe $electricity$ this station sends to its grid, or delivers to this state after losses, a week: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_electricity_moved_disp')|1]#!. At this flow $electricity$ here sells at #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_price_target_disp')|%0]#! of its base price.
TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_MOVED_TT.es: #b Flujo#!\nLa $electricity$ que esta estación envía a su red, o que entrega a este estado tras las pérdidas, a la semana: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_electricity_moved_disp')|1]#!. Con este flujo, la $electricity$ aquí se vende al #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_price_target_disp')|%0]#! de su precio base.

TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_PASS_TT.en: #b Pass-through#!\nThis station takes in its market's import: it buys #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_import_disp')|1]#! $grid_power$ a week from across the border and sells it into its own market at the same fixed price, which costs it nothing. Without it the market would buy far more $grid_power$ than it sells and read as short of it.
TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_PASS_TT.es: #b Tránsito#!\nEsta estación absorbe la importación de su mercado: compra #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_import_disp')|1]#! $grid_power$ a la semana al otro lado de la frontera y la vende en su propio mercado al mismo precio fijo, lo que no le cuesta nada. Sin ella, el mercado compraría mucha más $grid_power$ de la que vende y figuraría con déficit.

TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_SIZE_TT.en: #b Grid Size#!\nThe number of states whose stations share this state's [concept_power_grid].
TE_STATE_GRID_ROW_SIZE_TT.es: #b Tamaño de la red#!\nEl número de estados cuyas estaciones comparten la [concept_power_grid|l] de este estado.

TE_STATE_GRID_TT.en:
#bold [concept_power_grid]#!
This state's $building_grid_transfer_station$ shares $electricity$ with #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_region_size_disp')|0]#! states' stations. Once a month the grid moves $electricity$ until it sells at one price in the states that send it and at that price over their transmission efficiency in the states that receive it. Its supply against its demand: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_region_ratio_disp')|%0]#!.

Mode: #v $TE_STATE_GRID_MODE_NAME$#!
$building_grid_undersea_cable_range_add$: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_cable_range_disp')|0]#! [Concept('concept_sea_node', '$concept_sea_nodes|q$')]
TE_STATE_GRID_TT.es:
#bold [concept_power_grid]#!
La $building_grid_transfer_station$ de este estado comparte $electricity$ con las estaciones de #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_region_size_disp')|0]#! estados. Una vez al mes la red mueve $electricity$ hasta que se vende a un mismo precio en los estados que la envían y a ese precio dividido por su eficiencia de transmisión en los estados que la reciben. Su oferta frente a su demanda: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_region_ratio_disp')|%0]#!.

Modo: #v $TE_STATE_GRID_MODE_NAME$#!
$building_grid_undersea_cable_range_add$: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_grid_cable_range_disp')|0]#! [Concept('concept_sea_node', '$concept_sea_nodes|q$')|l]

TE_STATE_HOMELAND_TT.en:
#bold [concept_homeland_dynamics]#!
Creation Rate: #v +[State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_homeland_annual_progress')|1]%#! a year #grey (base 10%)#!
Removal Rate: #v +[State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_homeland_removal_annual_progress')|1]%#! a year #grey (slower under the UN Convention on Cultural Diversity)#!
Change Speed: [State.GetModifier.GetValueWithBreakdownFor('state_homeland_change_speed_mult')]
Creation Threshold: #tooltippable #tooltip:[State.GetTooltipTag],TE_HOMELAND_CREATION_THRESHOLD_TT #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_form_threshold')|%0]#!#!#! of the population
Removal Threshold: below #tooltippable #tooltip:[State.GetTooltipTag],TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_TT #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_disappear_threshold')|%0]#!#!#!
$TOOLTIP_DELIMITER$
#bold Multipliers#!
• State [concept_turmoil] #v 25%#! or more: #v ×1.25#!; #v 50%#! or more: #v ×1.5#!
• [concept_legitimacy] under #v 25#!: #v ×0.5#!; #v 75#! or more: #v ×1.25#!
$TOOLTIP_DELIMITER$
#bold Enabled by any one of#!
$TE_HOMELAND_UNLOCK_SOURCES$
TE_STATE_HOMELAND_TT.es:
#bold [concept_homeland_dynamics]#!
Tasa de creación: #v +[State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_homeland_annual_progress')|1]%#! al año #grey (base 10%)#!
Tasa de eliminación: #v +[State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_homeland_removal_annual_progress')|1]%#! al año #grey (más lenta bajo la Convención sobre la diversidad cultural de la ONU)#!
Velocidad de cambio: [State.GetModifier.GetValueWithBreakdownFor('state_homeland_change_speed_mult')]
Umbral de creación: #tooltippable #tooltip:[State.GetTooltipTag],TE_HOMELAND_CREATION_THRESHOLD_TT #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_form_threshold')|%0]#!#!#! de la población
Umbral de eliminación: por debajo de #tooltippable #tooltip:[State.GetTooltipTag],TE_HOMELAND_REMOVAL_THRESHOLD_TT #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('homeland_culture_disappear_threshold')|%0]#!#!#!
$TOOLTIP_DELIMITER$
#bold Multiplicadores#!
• [concept_turmoil] del estado #v 25%#! o más: #v ×1,25#!; #v 50%#! o más: #v ×1,5#!
• [concept_legitimacy] por debajo de #v 25#!: #v ×0,5#!; #v 75#! o más: #v ×1,25#!
$TOOLTIP_DELIMITER$
#bold Habilitado por cualquiera de estas cosas#!
$TE_HOMELAND_UNLOCK_SOURCES$

TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_TT.en: #bold Ocean Basin#!\nThis state's coast faces the $TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_NAME$ Ocean. A $building_ocean_mine$ here takes that basin's [concept_seabed_licence]s, and the state adds to its owner's claim weight there.\nEach basin's licenses and claims: the Seabed tab of the $te_systems_window_title$ window.
TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_TT.es: #bold Cuenca oceánica#!\nLa costa de este estado da al océano $TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_NAME$. Una $building_ocean_mine$ aquí ocupa las [Concept('concept_seabed_licence', 'licencias del lecho marino')] de esa cuenca, y el estado suma al peso de la reclamación de su propietario allí.\nLicencias y reclamaciones de cada cuenca: la pestaña Lecho marino de la ventana $te_systems_window_title$.

TE_STATE_SEABED_LICENCES_WAITING.en: #R [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_unrecorded')|0]#! wait for a license until we have a [concept_seabed_claim] to spare.
TE_STATE_SEABED_LICENCES_WAITING.es: #R [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_unrecorded')|0]#! esperan una licencia hasta que nos sobre una [concept_seabed_claim|l].

TE_STATE_SEABED_ROW_BASIN_TT.en: #b Ocean Basin#!\nThis state's coast faces the $TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_NAME$ Ocean. Its $building_ocean_mine$ levels take a $TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_NAME$ [concept_seabed_licence] first, and the state adds to our claim weight there.
TE_STATE_SEABED_ROW_BASIN_TT.es: #b Cuenca oceánica#!\nLa costa de este estado da al océano $TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_NAME$. Sus niveles de $building_ocean_mine$ toman primero una [concept_seabed_licence|l] del $TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_NAME$, y el estado suma al peso de nuestra reclamación allí.

TE_STATE_SEABED_ROW_CLAIMS_TT.en: #b Our Claims in the $TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_NAME$#!\nOur unused [concept_seabed_claim]s in this state's basin. A new $building_ocean_mine$ level here takes one and works at full throughput; with none left it takes another basin's license and works at #R -[State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_long_haul_penalty_pct')|0]%#!. As of the last monthly update.
TE_STATE_SEABED_ROW_CLAIMS_TT.es: #b Nuestras reclamaciones en el $TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_NAME$#!\nNuestras [Concept('concept_seabed_claim', 'reclamaciones del lecho marino')] sin usar en la cuenca de este estado. Un nuevo nivel de $building_ocean_mine$ aquí toma una y funciona a pleno rendimiento; si no queda ninguna, toma la licencia de otra cuenca y funciona con #R -[State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_long_haul_penalty_pct')|0]%#! de rendimiento. Según la última actualización mensual.

TE_STATE_SEABED_ROW_LICENCES_TT.en:
#b Licenses Here#!
This state has #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_levels')|0]#! $building_ocean_mine$ levels: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_built_levels')|0]#! built and #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_queued_levels')|0]#! queued. [concept_seabed_licence]s on them: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_records')|0]#!, #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_local_records')|0]#! from its own basin and #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_distant_records')|0]#! from others.[AddLocalizationIf(GreaterThan_CFixedPoint(State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_unrecorded'), '(CFixedPoint)0'), 'TE_STATE_SEABED_LICENCES_WAITING')]

A license stays with its level for good, and passes with the state if it changes hands.
TE_STATE_SEABED_ROW_LICENCES_TT.es:
#b Licencias aquí#!
Este estado tiene #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_levels')|0]#! niveles de $building_ocean_mine$: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_built_levels')|0]#! construidos y #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_queued_levels')|0]#! en cola. [Concept('concept_seabed_licence', 'Licencias del lecho marino')] en ellos: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_records')|0]#!, #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_local_records')|0]#! de su propia cuenca y #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_distant_records')|0]#! de otras.[AddLocalizationIf(GreaterThan_CFixedPoint(State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_unrecorded'), '(CFixedPoint)0'), 'TE_STATE_SEABED_LICENCES_WAITING')]

Una licencia se queda con su nivel para siempre, y pasa con el estado si este cambia de manos.

TE_STATE_SEABED_ROW_LONG_HAUL_TT.en: #b Long-Haul Licenses#!\n#R [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_distant_records')|0]#! of this state's levels hold another basin's [concept_seabed_licence], so its $building_ocean_mine$ carries $te_seabed_long_haul$: #R -[State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_long_haul_pct_disp')|0]%#! $building_ocean_mine$ throughput, -[State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_long_haul_penalty_pct')|0]% times their share of its licenses. At the next monthly update a free [concept_seabed_claim] in its own basin takes the place of one.
TE_STATE_SEABED_ROW_LONG_HAUL_TT.es: #b Licencias de larga distancia#!\n#R [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_distant_records')|0]#! de los niveles de este estado tienen una [concept_seabed_licence|l] de otra cuenca, por lo que su $building_ocean_mine$ soporta $te_seabed_long_haul$: #R -[State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_long_haul_pct_disp')|0]%#! de rendimiento de $building_ocean_mine$, -[State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_long_haul_penalty_pct')|0]% multiplicado por su parte en las licencias del estado. En la siguiente actualización mensual, una [concept_seabed_claim|l] libre en su propia cuenca ocupa el lugar de una.

TE_STATE_SEABED_ROW_WEIGHT_TT.en:
#b Claim Weight Here#!
What this state adds to our claim weight in the $TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_NAME$ now:
Coast: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_coast_term_disp')|0]#! ([State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_coast_weight')|0] for a coastal state, half that if unincorporated)
Port levels: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_port_levels')|0]#!
Naval share: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_navy_share_disp')|1]#! (our [Concept('concept_naval_power_projection','naval power projection')] ÷ [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_power_projection_scale')|0], doubled under Unilateral Licensing or the $te_seabed_regime_name_3$ regime, spread over our coast)
× #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_owner_factor_disp')|2]#! for our policy

[AddLocalizationIf(EqualTo_CFixedPoint(State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_weight_counts'), '(CFixedPoint)0'), 'TE_STATE_SEABED_WEIGHT_NONE')]Our weight in the $TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_NAME$ at the last sharing: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_basin_weight_disp')|1]#!. Each January's sharing counts it again.
TE_STATE_SEABED_ROW_WEIGHT_TT.es:
#b Peso de la reclamación aquí#!
Lo que este estado suma ahora al peso de nuestra reclamación en el $TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_NAME$:
Costa: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_coast_term_disp')|0]#! ([State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_coast_weight')|0] por un estado costero, la mitad si no está incorporado)
Niveles de puerto: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_port_levels')|0]#!
Parte naval: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_navy_share_disp')|1]#! (nuestra [Concept('concept_naval_power_projection','proyección de poder naval')] ÷ [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_power_projection_scale')|0], duplicada con Licencias unilaterales o con el régimen $te_seabed_regime_name_3$, repartida a lo largo de nuestra costa)
× #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_owner_factor_disp')|2]#! por nuestra política

[AddLocalizationIf(EqualTo_CFixedPoint(State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_weight_counts'), '(CFixedPoint)0'), 'TE_STATE_SEABED_WEIGHT_NONE')]Nuestro peso en el $TE_STATE_SEABED_BASIN_NAME$ en el último reparto: #v [State.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_state_basin_weight_disp')|1]#!. El reparto de cada enero lo cuenta de nuevo.

TE_STATE_SEABED_TT.en:
#bold [concept_seabed_licence]s#!
Across the country: #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_held_total')|0]#! in use of our #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_entitled_total')|0]#!, #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_distant_total')|0]#! of them from other basins
Room to build: #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_room_shown')|0]#!
Each basin's licenses and claims: the Seabed tab of the $te_systems_window_title$ window.
TE_STATE_SEABED_TT.es:
#bold [Concept('concept_seabed_licence', 'Licencias del lecho marino')]#!
En todo el país: #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_held_total')|0]#! en uso de nuestras #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_entitled_total')|0]#!, #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_distant_total')|0]#! de ellas de otras cuencas
Espacio para construir: #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('te_seabed_room_shown')|0]#!
Licencias y reclamaciones de cada cuenca: la pestaña Lecho marino de la ventana $te_systems_window_title$.

TE_STATE_SEABED_WEIGHT_NONE.en: #R None of it counts#! while we have relinquished this basin, or in the Southern Ocean while we are an Antarctic Treaty party.
TE_STATE_SEABED_WEIGHT_NONE.es: #R Nada de esto cuenta#! mientras hayamos renunciado a esta cuenca, o en el Océano Antártico mientras seamos parte del Tratado Antártico.

TE_STATE_SOLAR_TT.en:
#bold [concept_solar_collector_array] Slots#!
In Use: #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('solar_points_consumed')|0]#!
Reserved, queued levels included: #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('solar_points_reserved')|0]#!
Each fully staffed [concept_solar_collector_array] level gives the whole country #v 3#! Solar Receiver slots.
TE_STATE_SOLAR_TT.es:
#bold Ranuras de [concept_solar_collector_array|l]#!
En uso: #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('solar_points_consumed')|0]#!
Reservadas, con los niveles en cola incluidos: #v [State.GetOwner.MakeScope.ScriptValue('solar_points_reserved')|0]#!
Cada nivel de [concept_solar_collector_array|l] con plantilla completa da a todo el país #v 3#! ranuras para receptores solares.

TE_STATE_UN_FAIL_CONTRIBUTORS.en: if this country is attacked, or if every contributor leaves while the [concept_un_standing_force] does not serve in it
TE_STATE_UN_FAIL_CONTRIBUTORS.es: si este país es atacado, o si todos los contribuyentes se marchan mientras la [concept_un_standing_force|l] no presta servicio en ella

TE_STATE_UN_FAIL_ELECTORAL.en: if this country is attacked, or stops holding elections
TE_STATE_UN_FAIL_ELECTORAL.es: si este país es atacado o deja de celebrar elecciones

TE_STATE_UN_MISSION_BARRED.en: \n#v While the mission is here, a war goal the initiator of a play adds against this country, if the initiator is a represented member of the United Nations, is struck; unification goals and goals of the type the play opened with cost twice the usual infamy instead.#!
TE_STATE_UN_MISSION_BARRED.es: \n#v Mientras la misión esté aquí, se anula el objetivo de guerra que añada contra este país el iniciador de una jugada diplomática, si el iniciador es un miembro con representación de las Naciones Unidas; los objetivos de unificación y los del tipo con el que se abrió la jugada cuestan en su lugar el doble de la infamia habitual.#!

TE_STATE_UN_MISSION_FORCE.en: \nThe [concept_un_standing_force] serves in it as one more contributor.
TE_STATE_UN_MISSION_FORCE.es: \nLa [concept_un_standing_force] presta servicio en ella como un contribuyente más.

TE_STATE_UN_MISSION_OBSERVERS.en: \nIt is an electoral observer mission: its observers are paid from the UN's budget, and it has no contributors.
TE_STATE_UN_MISSION_OBSERVERS.es: \nEs una misión de observación electoral: sus observadores se pagan con el presupuesto de la ONU y no tiene contribuyentes.
